title: Prune Ruby PATH gems
description: Vendors a Ruby project's local PATH gems (in-repo gems referenced via `path:`) into a folder inside the project root so its Docker build can use a folder context instead of the repo root.

vendorDir.description: Directory, relative to the project root, the path gems are vendored into. Keep in sync with the target's `outputs`.

skip.description: Directory basenames excluded when copying each path gem.
